_comment: Measured configurations for the end-to-end tests (tests/test_e2e.py). Each entry's argv is exactly what the suite passes to pdf_ocr.py (after the PDF, -o, --models-dir and --pages), and its settings are the part of the JSON `settings` the measurement depends on; tests/test_baseline.py checks both without a GPU. Error rates were measured with ocr_eval.py (dash kinds folded, display formulas skipped; see the README 'Tuning notes') and apply only to the document and pages below: with another PDF or other pages the check is skipped unless PDF_OCR_CER_BOUND is set. Rule for each bound: measured error rate + 0.05 percentage points, rounded up to the next 0.05 percentage points. Measured on an RTX 4070 Ti 12 GB; errors/ref_chars are ocr_eval.py's total (incl. 1 text-layer character in no Block); wall_seconds is the whole CLI run including model load; peak_vram_mib is the whole card, which has about 1 GB of desktop use. This is NOT the original 21-page sample (sha256 92edbf79...), which is not available; numbers here are not comparable with the earlier 0.40 % figure.
